note: The City of Irving ordinance ORD-2012-9339 canvasses the general municipal election of May 12, 2012. It was opened as a scanned PDF through the Internet Archive and read by OCR. The ordinance states the election was held to elect City Council Places 4, 6 and 8. It lists no mayoral contest. The attached Dallas County joint election report for May 12, 2012 lists only council contests for Irving. The ordinance sets a runoff on June 23, 2012 between Phil Riddle and Joe Putnam for Council Place 4, so no mayoral round was held in 2012. The mayor was elected in 2011 and 2014, which fits the three-year charter cycle (Charter Art. IV Secs. 6 and 8).
